Stereon benchmark trend

stereon_bench on every push to main: the median CPU time per evaluated item (per iteration where nothing is counted) over the repetitions of each run, the last 60 runs. Latest: 2c27315 on 2026-11-06, AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor. Hosted runners differ from run to run, so a step in a chart is read against the CPU in its points' titles. The change shown is against the run before; above 10% it is marked.
